## Sound2Word: reading Malayalam words aloud for a speech-recognition study

**Who is running this:** [PROJECT OWNER / ORGANISATION]. **Contact:** [CONTACT METHOD - not printed here].

### What is this about?
Sound2Word is an experimental program that tries to recognise spoken Malayalam words. We want to find out how well it works for different voices. This is a small
feasibility study with about [NUMBER] people. **Taking part does not mean the program will recognise your words accurately.** Results are experimental.

### What would I do?
You would read a list of Malayalam words aloud, one at a time, in your normal way of speaking, in [NUMBER] session(s) of about [MINUTES] minutes. Some words may repeat.
We will not tell you how to pronounce a word and we are not testing you: there are no right or wrong voices or accents. You can pause, skip a word or stop at any time.

### What will be collected?
- Voice recordings of you reading the words, and information computed from them (for example sound features).
- A random participant code (such as SPK-___) instead of your name; session numbers; the recording device and room details.
- Only if you choose to: your age group, gender, or accent/region. You may answer "prefer not to say" to any of these.
Your name and contact details are kept **separately**, in a restricted place, only so we can reach you about your participation or a withdrawal request.

### How will the recordings be used?
To build and test a speech-recognition program. Recordings and derived features will be processed on [LOCATION / SYSTEMS]. They will **not** be uploaded to external AI or transcription services.

### Who can see them, where are they kept, for how long?
- Access: [NAMED ROLES - as few as possible]. Storage: [ENCRYPTED LOCATION]. They are kept until [RETENTION DATE], then deleted unless you agree to something different.
- We do **not** plan to share your recordings outside the project. Any future sharing or public release would be a **separate decision** and would need your explicit permission first.
- Results reported from the study are summaries (for example accuracy numbers) and do not identify you. Groups too small to protect privacy are not reported separately.

### Optional extras (you can say yes or no to each, and still take part)
- Using your recordings in **future experiments** of this project.
- Using your optional details (age group, gender, accent) to look at results by group.
- Public release of recordings: **not offered in this study.**

### Can I change my mind?
Yes. Taking part is voluntary. Saying no, or stopping later, will not affect any unrelated service or your relationship with [ORGANISATION / PERSON]. To withdraw, contact [CONTACT METHOD]. We will then remove your recordings from
future analysis and delete [WHAT WILL BE DELETED, AS APPROVED]. Results already calculated and summaries already shared cannot be un-published, but they do not identify you.

### Questions or concerns
Please contact [CONTACT METHOD] or [INDEPENDENT CONTACT / REVIEWER FOR CONCERNS].
